Camera: full-body near-side lateral view, slightly oblique (about 10 degrees toward the foot end) so that BOTH legs and both feet are clearly separated and visible, fixed level camera, natural anatomy, head at left and feet at right. Show complete head, hands, shoes and entire mat with comfortable margins.
Action 079 T-LOW-047 step s01: START of right-leg single-leg glute bridge, pelvis NOT raised. Woman supine, head, shoulder blades, back and buttocks resting on mat. Both arms rest beside torso, palms down on mat. Near-side RIGHT knee bent, RIGHT foot sole completely flat and securely planted on mat, foot at normal bridge distance from buttocks. Far-side LEFT leg is non-supporting: left knee stays bent about 90 degrees, LEFT foot is gently lifted completely clear of mat with an unambiguous visible air gap; bent left leg is raised just enough to remove support, not kicked high, not straightened. Pelvis level and resting, neutral relaxed lower back, no hip lift. Left foot must be distinguishable from the planted right foot, do not superimpose them. Exactly two legs, two arms and two shoes, continuous natural joints.
This will be first of a matched pair. Keep a visually clear difference between planted right sole and floating left shoe. No text, letters, labels, arrows, motion trails, logos, watermark, collage, split panel or duplicated person.
